source_note: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散
english_source_note: Competing Decreasing Sequences and Series Divergence
callout_id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#10
statement_en:
Let $f(x)$ be a nonnegative locally integrable nonincreasing function on $[1,+\infty)$, and suppose
$$\int_1^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx=+\infty.$$ Then
$$\int_{1}^{+\infty}\min\{f(x),\frac{1}{x}\}\,dx=+\infty.$$
callout_body: 若非负函数$f(x)$在$[1,+\infty)$上局部可积单调不增，且$\int_1^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx=+\infty$那么积分$$\int_{1}^{+\infty}\min\{f(x),\frac{1}{x}\}\,dx=+\infty$$
